item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Ukraine has intensified its campaign against the Kerch bridge, striking it with drones and causing a partial collapse, while Russia announced plans to rebuild the structure stronger. Russian officials warned that an EU delegation would not be forced to join Ukraine talks, contrasting with Moscow's reconstruction pledge. The conflict continues to generate high casualties, with 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
